base_earn.note: The published page states category and channel rates rather than a single base rate, so no base rate is asserted here.

conditions: Stated for selected categories on the Tata Neu App or website after registering for NeuPass.
From 2025-01-15 the published terms restrict this to transactions on the primary cardholder's mobile number account.
Stated for eligible UPI spends on the RuPay variant from 2024-08-01.
Published as additional to the 0.5% UPI rate when paying via a Tata Neu UPI ID.
The published terms cap NeuCoins earned on grocery transactions without restating the rate, so only the cap is recorded.

exclusions: Fuel, wallet, rental, government and online gaming transactions are stated as not accruing NeuCoins.
No automated redemption authorization is implied.

expiry.note: Stated from 2025-08-01, including the lock period.

valuation.note: Deliberately unpriced. The fetched issuer page does not state a rupee value for a NeuCoin, and an estimated valuation would make this card look comparable to others while being an invention. Comparison across currencies stays unavailable until a real price is sourced.
